5.15.eg: OWS + 15 ppm alarm: test in front of the inspector, genuine sample flow, seals.
ex: Engineers know the OWS and the equipment works correctly.
Alarm not activated or valve does not turn above 15 ppm
Sampling valve not sealed by Class
With C/E agreement he will see the OWS running and an alarm test with a sample above 15 ppm
Closes the sampling valve to see the reaction
Calibration of the 15 ppm meter every 5 years
5.15.fg: OWS + 15 ppm alarm: test sa harap ng inspector, totoong sample flow, seals.
fc: Umaandar ang OWS; 15ppm monitor calibration certificate (≤5 taon)
Alarm at 3-way valve nagre-recirculate kapag >15 ppm (ipakita)
Totoo ang sample flow – walang daya na fresh water flushing
Naka-seal ang overboard valve; naka-log ang seal numbers
Alam ng engineers ang procedure
fx: Alam ng engineers ang OWS at tama ang andar ng equipment.
Hindi nag-a-alarm o hindi lumilipat ang valve sa itaas ng 15 ppm
Hindi naka-seal ng Class ang sampling valve
Kung payag ang C/E, titingnan ang andar ng OWS at alarm test gamit ang sample na >15 ppm
Isinasara ang sampling valve para makita ang reaksyon
Calibration ng 15 ppm meter bawat 5 taon
ff: Hindi maipakita ng officer ang test / hindi nagre-recirculate ang 3-way valve
Puwedeng i-flush ng fresh water ang sample line, hindi naka-seal

5.18.eg: HME declaration from the shipper for every cargo.
5.18.fg: HME declaration mula sa shipper para sa bawat cargo.
fc: HME / non-HME declaration ng shipper para sa kasalukuyan at huling cargo

5.19.eg: Garbage Management Plan & GRB correct, segregation, receipts.
ex: Garbage Management Plan and a correct Garbage Record Book.
5.19.fg: Tama ang Garbage Management Plan at GRB, segregation, resibo.
fc: Ship-specific ang GMP; may designated garbage officer
GRB Part I (at II para sa cargo residues) entries na may category, m³, positions
Port reception receipts itinatago nang 2 taon
Color-coded/may label ang bins; nakapaskil ang placards
fx: Garbage Management Plan at tamang Garbage Record Book.

5.21.fg: Aprubado ang SEEMP Part I/II/III (CII plan).
fc: Aprubado ang SEEMP Part III (CII implementation plan); DCS data
Alamin ang kasalukuyang CII rating at corrective plan kung D/E
fx: SEEMP Part III para sa CII

5.23.eg: Scrubber (if fitted): operation, wash water monitoring, procedures.
ex: Scrubber working well, engineers know it, procedures in the SMS.
Soot on the water from the wash water
5.23.fg: Scrubber (kung meron): andar, wash water monitoring, procedures.
fc: Umaandar ang EGCS, monitoring records (pH, PAH, turbidity)
Pamilyar ang engineers; nasa SMS ang procedures
Walang uling sa tubig mula sa washwater discharge
fx: Maayos ang andar ng scrubber, alam ito ng engineers, nasa SMS ang procedures.
May uling sa tubig mula sa wash water

5.25.eg: Ballast pumps, valves, remote control panel, gauges, draft gauges working.
ex: Ballast pumps, instruments, valves, piping and control panel working.
5.25.fg: Gumagana ang ballast pumps, valves, remote control panel, gauges, draft gauges.
fc: Ballast control panel – tama ang valve indications, walang sirang valve
Gumagana ang pressure gauges at remote sounding/draft gauges
Walang leak/temporary repair sa ballast piping
fx: Gumagana ang ballast pumps, instruments, valves, piping at control panel.

5.26.eg: Bunker & ballast tank manholes in good condition (bolts, gaskets).
ex: Manholes of bunker and ballast tanks in good condition.
5.26.fg: Maayos ang manholes ng bunker at ballast tanks (bolts, gaskets).
fc: Kumpleto ang bolts, maayos ang gaskets, walang leak/kalawang
fx: Maayos ang manholes ng bunker at ballast tanks.
Kulang ang bolts o may leak

5.27.eg: Sewage plant working, blowers, pumps, piping; crew know it.
ex: Sewage plant in good condition and the crew know it.
5.27.fg: Gumagana ang sewage plant, blowers, pumps, piping; alam ng crew.
fc: Umaandar ang STP, walang amoy/leak; gumagana ang blowers at discharge pumps
Chlorine/disinfectant, sludge records; certificate of type approval
fx: Maayos ang sewage plant at alam ito ng crew.

6.1.eg: No hull repair without informing Class.
ex: No repair to the hull without Class knowing.
Documents or visible signs of repair without approval
6.1.fg: Walang hull repair nang hindi alam ng Class.
fc: Lahat ng doublers/inserts/repairs ay ini-report sa Class at naka-record
Ikutin ang deck/holds para sa doublers o welding na walang paliwanag
fx: Walang repair sa hull nang hindi alam ng Class.
May dokumento o nakikitang repair na walang approval

6.2.eg: Crew inspections of holds/ballast tanks/voids WITH photos/video.
ex: An SMS procedure for regular crew inspections of holds, ballast tanks, voids, duct keel, with records.
6.2.fg: Inspection ng crew sa holds/ballast tanks/voids NA MAY picture/video.
fc: SMS schedule para sa crew inspections ng holds, ballast tanks, voids, duct keel
Inspection report ng bawat space na may PICTURE/VIDEO (finding kung wala)
May rating ang coating condition, sinusundan ang defects
fx: May SMS procedure para sa regular na inspection ng crew sa holds, ballast tanks, voids, duct keel, may records.
Report na walang picture o video

6.3.eg: ESP file (Enhanced Survey Programme) complete, condition evaluation report.
ex: ESP file complete, and the condition evaluation report shows the ship is fit for the next 5 years.
6.3.fg: Kumpleto ang ESP file (Enhanced Survey Programme), condition evaluation report.
fc: ESP survey report file: thickness measurements, close-up surveys, condition evaluation report
Kinukumpirma ng executive hull summary na fit sa 5 taon
fx: Kumpleto ang ESP file, at ipinapakita ng condition evaluation report na fit ang barko sa susunod na 5 taon.

6.4.eg: Hold/tank ladders (vertical, spiral, rungs, platforms) not wasted/bent.
ex: Ladders, rungs and platforms in holds, tanks and voids in good condition.
Rusty, bent or wasted ladders or rungs
6.4.fg: Hagdan ng holds/tanks (vertical, spiral, rungs, platforms) hindi bulok/baluktot.
fc: I-check ang hold ladders: hindi bulok/baluktot ang rungs, matibay ang cages at platforms, walang kulang
Gumagana ang Australian ladder/access hatches
Ayusin ang anumang defect bago ang inspection
fx: Maayos ang hagdan, rungs at platforms sa holds, tanks at voids.
Kalawangin, baluktot o bulok na hagdan o rungs

6.5.eg: Air & sounding pipes inside the holds in good condition (guards).
ex: Air and sounding pipes in holds and voids in good condition.
6.5.fg: Maayos ang air at sounding pipes sa loob ng holds (guards).
fc: Hindi yupi/bulok ang pipes sa holds; buo ang protective guards
Nasa lugar ang caps/covers
fx: Maayos ang air at sounding pipes sa holds at voids.

6.6.eg: Duct keel: access, ventilation, lighting, dry.
ex: If there is a duct keel: access, ventilation, lighting, no water.
6.6.fg: Duct keel: daanan, ventilation, ilaw, tuyo.
fc: Tuyo, may ilaw at gumagana ang fan sa duct keel; nakapaskil ang entry procedure
Walang leak mula sa pipes sa loob
fx: Kung may duct keel: daanan, ventilation, ilaw, walang tubig.
May tubig o mahina ang ventilation

6.7.eg: No visible structural damage (frames, brackets, hopper, coamings).
6.7.fg: Walang nakikitang structural damage (frames, brackets, hopper, coamings).
fc: Holds: hindi natanggal/baluktot ang frames/brackets; hopper at topside tank plating
Hatch coamings at stays, walang bitak/baluktot ang deck plating
Tandaan ang grab damage – ayusin o i-report sa Class
fx: May damage (hal. may bitak o baluktot na frames)
Isinusulat kung aling area ang chine-check niya

6.8.eg: Hold ventilation (fans, mushrooms, flaps) works and closes.
6.8.fg: Gumagana at sumasara ang hold ventilation (fans, mushrooms, flaps).
fc: Malayang bumubukas/sumasara ang hold vents; flame screens; markang open/close
Umaandar ang fans (kung meron)

7A.1.eg: Save-all under the bunker manifolds clean and empty with plug.
ex: Save-all under the bunker manifolds, clean and empty.
7A.1.fg: Malinis at walang laman ang save-all sa ilalim ng bunker manifolds, may plug.
fc: Malinis at walang laman ang manifold drip tray, may drain plug
May sorbents/SOPEP kit sa malapit
fx: Malinis at walang laman ang save-all sa ilalim ng bunker manifolds.

7A.2.eg: Bunker lines hydrostatic test: annually at MAWP, 1.5×MAWP twice in 5 years.
ex: Hydrostatic test of bunker lines: annually at MAWP and at 1.5×MAWP twice in every 5 years.
7A.2.fg: Hydrostatic test ng bunker lines: taon-taon sa MAWP, 1.5×MAWP dalawang beses sa 5 taon.
fc: Pressure test records at marka ng test date/pressure sa line
Test certificates nasa PMS
fx: Hydrostatic test ng bunker lines: taon-taon sa MAWP at sa 1.5×MAWP dalawang beses bawat 5 taon.

7A.3.eg: Bunker manifold: drains, vents, gauges, thermometers OK, blanks with all bolts.
ex: Drains, vents and instruments at the manifolds in good condition, and blanks fitted when not in use.
7A.3.fg: Bunker manifold: OK ang drains, vents, gauges, thermometers, blanks na kumpleto ang bolts.
fc: Blank flanges na kumpleto ang bolts kapag hindi ginagamit
Gumagana at calibrated ang pressure gauges; sarado ang drain cocks
fx: Maayos ang drains, vents at instruments sa manifolds, at may blanks kapag hindi ginagamit.
Walang blanks o kulang ang bolts

7A.4.eg: Save-alls at FO/DO/LO tank vents clean, plug fixed with a chain.
ex: Save-alls around fuel/diesel/lube tank vents, clean, with the plug tied by a chain.
7A.4.fg: Malinis ang save-alls sa vents ng FO/DO/LO tanks, nakakadena ang plug.
fc: May save-alls sa lahat ng fuel/lube tank vents, malinis at walang laman
Drain plug naka-secure ng kadena
fx: May save-alls sa paligid ng vents ng fuel/diesel/lube tanks, malinis, at nakakadena ang plug.

7A.5.eg: FO/LO/hydraulic oil analysis per maker, action on results.
ex: Procedures for fuel, lube and hydraulic oil analysis, at maker's frequency.
7A.5.fg: FO/LO/hydraulic oil analysis ayon sa maker, may aksyon sa resulta.
fc: Bunker analysis (hal. VPS/DNV) sa bawat stem
LO analysis ME/AE/stern tube sa interval ng maker; hydraulic oil (hatch, cranes, steering)
May aksyon sa recommendations (finding kung binalewala)
fx: May procedures para sa fuel, lube at hydraulic oil analysis, sa dalas ayon sa maker.
Hindi sinusunod ang dalas ng maker

7A.7.eg: Bunkering plan, checklist, pre-bunker meeting; last bunkering correct.
ex: Bunkering and transfers planned and carried out to industry standards.
7A.7.fg: Bunkering plan, checklist, pre-bunker meeting; tama ang huling bunkering.
fc: Bunker plan at pre-bunkering checklist ng huling bunkering
Tank max 85–90%, sounding records, komunikasyon, handa ang SOPEP
Itinago ang Bunker Delivery Note at MARPOL sample
fx: Ang bunkering at transfers ay planado at ginawa ayon sa industry standards.

7A.9.eg: Fuel changeover procedure & log for ECA.
ex: Fuel changeover procedure for ECA and a correct changeover log.
7A.9.fg: Fuel changeover procedure at log para sa ECA.
fc: Ship-specific changeover procedure at calculation
Changeover log: oras, positions, tank volumes – tugma sa deck log
fx: Procedure sa pagpapalit ng fuel para sa ECA at tamang changeover log.

7A.10.eg: Quick closing valves tested and working.
ex: Quick closing valves tested and in good condition.
7A.10.fg: Nasubukan at gumagana ang quick closing valves.
fc: QCV test records (bawat valve) ayon sa PMS
May marka ang remote station at handa ang air/hydraulic system
Hindi naka-wedge/naka-block na bukas ang valves
fx: Nasubukan at maayos ang quick closing valves.

7A.11.eg: High-pressure fuel pipes jacketed with a leak alarm that is tested.
ex: HP fuel pipes with jacket and a tested leak alarm.
7A.11.fg: Jacketed ang high-pressure fuel pipes na may leak alarm na sinusubukan.
fc: Jacketed HP lines sa ME/AE; nasubukan at naka-record ang leak tank alarms
fx: HP fuel pipes na may jacket at nasubukang leak alarm.

7A.12.eg: Purifier room: clean, no leaks, ventilation, fire protection.
ex: Purifier room ventilated, clean, no leaks.
7A.12.fg: Purifier room: malinis, walang leak, ventilation, fire protection.
fc: Malinis ang purifier room, walang langis sa sahig, walang leak
Umaandar ang ventilation; fire flaps; malinis ang drip trays
fx: May hangin, malinis at walang leak ang purifier room.

7A.13.eg: Emergency generator tank full for ≥18 hours.
ex: Emergency generator tank full for at least 18 hours.
7A.13.fg: Puno ang tank ng emergency generator para sa ≥18 oras.
fc: Level ng em'cy gen fuel tank kumpara sa 18h na konsumo; self-closing ang gauge glass
Angkop na fuel (MGO), walang tubig
📋 Inspector: Emergency generator: fuel for 18 hours, insulation readings, quick-closing valve on the tank
fx: Puno ang tank ng emergency generator para sa hindi bababa sa 18 oras.

8A.2.eg: Cargo information (IMSBC) from the shipper before loading.
ex: The shipper has given cargo information before loading.
8A.2.fg: Cargo information (IMSBC) mula sa shipper bago magkarga.
fc: Cargo declaration ng shipper (IMSBC 4.2) – BCSN, group, properties
fx: Nagbigay ang shipper ng cargo information bago magkarga.

8A.3.eg: MC/TML certificate, angle of repose, density – signed; no cargo damage.
ex: A signed certificate with MC, TML, angle of repose and density, and cargo without damage.
Cargo damage from any cause other than hatch cover weathertightness
8A.3.fg: MC/TML certificate, angle of repose, density – may pirma; walang cargo damage.
fc: MC at TML certificate may pirma, sampling ≤7 araw, para sa Group A cargoes
Angle of repose/density info
Walang cargo damage claim dahil sa ibang dahilan
fx: Certificate na may pirma na may MC, TML, angle of repose at density, at cargo na walang damage.
Cargo damage dahil sa ibang dahilan bukod sa weathertightness ng hatch covers

8A.4.eg: Information on ballast rates, tank top max load, max load per hold.
ex: Data available for ballast rates, tank top max load and max load per hold.
8A.4.fg: Impormasyon sa ballast rates, tank top max load, max load bawat hold.
fc: Nakapaskil/alam ang ballast/deballast rates
Madaling makuha ang tank top permissible loads, max hold loads (loading manual)
fx: May data para sa ballast rates, tank top max load at max load bawat hold.
